summary.en: Information through 09:00 EST: S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 futures are up 0.97% and 1.71% versus the prior cash-close reference after Wednesday's mixed session. Official initial jobless claims rose to 203,000 from a revised 202,000. Wednesday's minutes discussion keeps rate risk in focus; the 10-year yield is 5.085%. Palo Alto Networks' fiscal Q1 report came after its 9.9% regular-session gain, and the dollar is slightly lower while oil rebounds.
summary.zh: 信息截至纽约时间09:00 EST：周三涨跌互现后，标普500和纳指100期货较前一现金收盘参考点涨0.97%、1.71%。官方初请失业金人数增至203,000人，前周修正为202,000人。周三会议纪要讨论使利率风险仍受关注，10年期收益率为5.085%。PANW第一财季报告在其常规交易涨9.9%之后公布；美元微跌，原油反弹。

title.en: Wednesday recap: indexes finish mixed while retailers advance
title.zh: 周三回顾：股指收盘分化，零售股走强

impact.en: MT Newswires' Wednesday post-close review describes a mixed market and minutes favoring further tightening. A couple of participants discussed a move larger than 25 basis points if incoming inflation data proved unfavorable; this was conditional discussion. TJX rose 8.1% after raising its full-year outlook, while Target gained 4% with a higher full-year sales outlook.
impact.zh: MT Newswires周三盘后综述记录股市分化及纪要中进一步收紧的倾向。少数与会者讨论了若后续通胀数据不利，可能加息超过25个基点，属于有条件讨论。TJX上调全年展望后涨8.1%，Target上调全年销售展望后涨4%。

bullish: TJX与Target上调全年展望 / TJX and Target raised full-year outlooks.
bearish: 进一步收紧预期可能约束估值 / Further-tightening expectations may constrain valuations.

macroRisk.en: The minutes recount an earlier meeting; they are not a new rate decision or a commitment to a 50-basis-point increase in December.
macroRisk.zh: 纪要回顾此前会议，不是新的利率决议，也不等于承诺12月加息50个基点。

title.en: Palo Alto Networks reports after Wednesday's close; UNH falls in regular trading
title.zh: PANW周三盘后发布财报；UNH在常规交易中下跌

impact.en: The 16:23 EST account says PANW gained 9.9% during Wednesday's regular session and extended its rally after hours as fiscal Q1 results were released. The regular-session gain preceded that report. Separately, UNH fell 10% in regular trading as insurance shares weakened. The source does not give a percentage for PANW's after-hours gain.
impact.zh: 16:23 EST报道指出，PANW周三常规交易涨9.9%，随后公布第一财季业绩，盘后延续涨势；常规交易涨幅发生在这份财报之前。另据报道，保险股走弱时UNH常规交易跌10%。该文未给出PANW盘后涨幅百分比。

bullish: 报道记录PANW盘后延续上涨 / The account records a further PANW rise after hours.
bearish: UNH下跌体现行业表现分化 / UNH's decline illustrates sector divergence.

macroRisk.en: After-hours moves may not persist into the next cash session. A regular-session return and a later earnings reaction describe different trading periods.
macroRisk.zh: 盘后走势未必延续至下一现货时段；常规交易收益与随后财报反应属于不同时段。

title.en: Initial jobless claims rise to 203,000 in the week ending November 14
title.zh: 截至11月14日当周初请失业金人数增至203,000人

impact.en: The Labor Department's 08:30 EST release puts seasonally adjusted initial claims at 203,000, up 1,000 from a revised 202,000. The four-week average rose to 197,750. Continuing insured unemployment for the separate week ending November 7 rose 70,000 to 1,763,000; its reference week differs from initial claims.
impact.zh: 劳工部08:30 EST公布，季调初请人数203,000人，较前周修正后的202,000人增1,000人，四周均值升至197,750人。另一个统计周、截至11月7日的续请人数增70,000人至1,763,000人，期间与初请不同。

bearish: 初请、续请及初请四周均值均上升 / Initial claims, continuing claims and the initial-claims four-week average rose.

macroRisk.en: Claims are preliminary and subject to revision. Continuing claims use an earlier reference week; neither series alone determines the monthly unemployment rate or the next Fed decision.
macroRisk.zh: 申领数据为初值且可能修正；续请使用较早统计周，单项数据不能决定月度失业率或美联储下一次行动。

keyRisk.en: Official weekly claims have been released at 08:30 EST. Watch whether the equity rebound broadens beyond technology while Treasury yields remain firm. Treat the earlier minutes' conditional rate discussion separately from a new FOMC decision.
keyRisk.zh: 官方周度失业金数据已于08:30 EST公布。关注收益率仍坚挺时，股票反弹能否扩散至科技以外；此前纪要中有条件的利率讨论，应与新的FOMC决议区分。

note.en: I lean toward a recovery attempt, with rate sensitivity still limiting confidence. Nasdaq-100 futures rise 1.71%, ahead of S&P 500 futures at 0.97% and Dow futures at 0.51%, showing technology leadership. The dollar falls 0.10%, but the 10-year yield rises 1.9 basis points to 5.085% and WTI gains 1.88%, creating competing currency, rate and cost signals. Initial and continuing claims increased in different reference weeks; this does not establish a sudden labor-market turn. Watch breadth after the cash open: broader participation with stable yields would strengthen recovery; a narrowing technology rally alongside rising yields would weaken it.
note.zh: 我倾向于将盘前表现视为修复尝试，利率敏感性仍限制信心。纳指100期货涨1.71%，领先标普500的0.97%和道指的0.51%，体现科技带动。美元跌0.10%，但10年期收益率升1.9个基点至5.085%，WTI涨1.88%，汇率、利率与成本信号相互牵制。初请、续请在不同统计周均增加，尚不足以确立劳动力市场骤然转向。关注现货开盘后广度：若参与面扩散且收益率稳定，将增强修复判断；若涨势收窄至科技、收益率同时上行，则会削弱它。
